batting.name: R Dravid

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DJ Bravo

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b JA Morkel

batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b R Ashwin

batting.name: SK Warne
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b SK Raina

balls.text: it's a full toss well outside off, Morkel cuts straight to point and they get only a single. A bit of a whimper in the 20th, but CSK have finished with 196.
he keeps it short again, Dhoni pulls and finds the man in the deep. Only one. Over to Albie for the last ball.
so far, a pretty good over. Another short ball, hurries past Dhoni's attempted pull. Too quick for him this time.

bad time to bowl a wide, angled too far outside off and Morkel can't make contact with it. Dhoni was always coming for the run, and Morkel responded though the keeper tried to under-arm it to the bowler's end.
short again, Dhoni finds wide mid-on with another hard-bunted pull.

does Dhoni guzzle milk or gasoline? Somehow he managed to get a couple here. Short ball, he's smashed the pull straight to deep midwicket, for what looked like a single. And then he bustled all the way back. Easily.
short and hustling Morkel with pace, he is late on the pull and it pops up into the covers for a single

It's one of those Dhoni nights in Jaipur. Anything on a length is going to be deposited high and far. Amit Singh's pace lends itself to this brand of violence, and Dhoni ensures it doesn't escape punishment. Butchered over long-on with one clean swing. Watch out, folks in the stands.
length ball on the pads, Morkel whips to square leg and they get another single.
full on his pads, Albie pushes towards the vacant midwicket region and Dhoni ensures they pick a couple.

Amit's cut the damages a bit by getting rid of Raina. Canny little slow offcutter on leg stump and breaking across Raina, who swings hard and misses the heave over the leg side. Off stump is pegged back.
leg stump again, back of a length and sitting up. Raina mistimes the pull but gets a single to the deep.
full ball on Raina's toes, he manages to whip it through midwicket for a couple

thumped. Watson pitches further up, Dhoni pulls put the roundhouse kick and sends this packing over the straight boundary. Length ball, in the Dhoni swinging range and he brutalises it. He's pranced away to 31 off 14 balls.
Dhoni is looking really menacing today. Short of a length ball and Dhoni fore-hands down the line for four. Easy as they come.
short of a length, cramping Dhoni for room as he backs away again and he ends up pushing it without timing into the covers for a couple.
interesting call from the umpire. Dhoni goes a mile down the leg side, Watson follows him and sends it down the leg side even as Dhoni trots back into line. Not called a wide.
low full toss outside off, Raina gets another single through the off side.
Raina scoops the first ball over the covers. Full toss outside off, Raina, smartly lofts over the infield and the ball runs away to the longer boundary. Again.

Rajasthan have tried too hard to protect the shorter boundary today, and have leaked runs on the other side. Trivedi wafts another slowish ball well outside off and Dhoni whacks it through cover-point for four more. Poor, poor bowling.
short ball to Raina, he rolls the wrists over the pull and gets a single to midwicket.
Dhoni was looking for two, but gets just one. Length ball on off stump, he chips it away to midwicket for a single with soft hands, but not soft enough.
this is abject bowling. Trivedi sends down a listless full toss a foot and a bit outside off and Dhoni throws his bat at it. Thick edge runs aqay between point and third man.
short again, Trivedi's usual variation in pace, Dhoni backs away waits and smites over the covers.

aha, Dhoni has deposited Trivedi deep into the Pink City. He didn't advance out his crease as much as run down it. Trivedi landed it on a length, and Dhoni oblinged by carting it onto the roof of the first tier.
Dhoni hangs back and forces a length ball into the covers for one.
cramps Dhoni for room outside off with a speared offie that hurried through.
Raina forces another single to long-off.
Dhoni hangs back and hacks away a short-of-length ball outside off for a single
tossed up by Botha on the pads, Raina works it to mid-on for a single.
ripping turner away from MSD from outside off, he plays a cut and gets it away to point.
loopy ball outside off, Raina pushes down to long off for a single.

do we finally have a run out? Thirs umpire called for. Tossed up on middle and leg, Vijay looks to sweep and is too early in the shot. It takes the toe end of the bat and runs towards backward point. This time, Raina ran hard and Vijay trotted listlessly. The direct throw from Botha caught him short at the bowler's end by a few inches. Vijay is livid with himself, and rightly so.
Warne's clearly concerned by the short boundary, and lands this miles outside off.
heaved into the leg side, there is a sweeper on midwicket now and they get just one.

Warne is standing mid-pitch with his arms crossed. This isn't fun. Raina is toying with him. Tossed up on off and breaking in, Raina cover drives against the spin and eludes a diving Menaria inside the circle to pick up four more.

Raina picked his spot an hour early. This was always going over square leg. Warne helped it by dropping short on off, and Raina pounced on it with a pull shot. Longer boundary, meant he only got four.
Raina looks to jump out, Amit keeps it tight and ensures he can't swing freely. Pushed into the covers for a single.
another potential run out, another miss. Full and wide outside off, Raina steers straight to cover. Vijay wanted one, Raina did not respond. Throw missed once again.
no wonder Raina refused the second. Length ball outside off, he's pounded it fiercely through covers. RR are taking a beating here.

hare-brained running, but they get away with it. Vijay laps Amit from outside off towards fine leg and screams away for the first run. He always wanted two, and hared right back, but Raina was not at all interested. Throw came to the keeper who then had a go at the bowler's end, and missed.
on Raina's pads now, easily worked down to fine leg for a single.
Vijay backs away, Amit follows him and jeeps it on a length on the pads. Nudged away quietly for a single.
clatter. The short boundary is really short. Back of a length ball outside off, Raina stands tall and thumps it on the up through the covers. The sweeper is there for effect, he has no chance.
angled in from very wide of the crease, he's close to cutting the return crease. Raina has a big swish outside off and misses.
length ball outside off, played down to long on for two more.
slower ball, comes onto the pads and Vijay waits to nudge it through square leg for one.
Jaipur, get some protection. Vijay is in that mood today. Length ball, angles into the body from off and he moves the front foot across and slaps it over square leg for six. Fifty for the man.
slower ball on the pads, Vijay turns it away through midwicket for a couple. They are running like the wind.
Raina is into the act now, drilling Watson through the covers with an emphatic twirl of the wrists. Lovely shot that, stayed along the ground and threaded the extra-cover gap.
angles away from a length, Raina stays rooted and has a big swing at it. He misses.
back of a length outside off, Raina stays on the crease and nudges through midwicket for an easy couple.
slower ball on off stump, Vijay pushes into the covers for another single
short ball, hurries onto Vijay but he does well to control the pull and get a couple through midwicket
Vijay's best IPL innings came against RR last year. Encore coming up? He picks up a length ball and bashes Watson like a net bowler down the ground. Bang, bang, he shot me down ...

lovely ball, nearly owned Vijay there as he first thought of advancing, and then belatedly realised it was the quicker one homing in on off stump. Vijay is good enough to hang back and defend into the off side.
flighted outside off, Raina pushes towards long off for one
drift in towards the pads, Raina leans out and defends.
Vijay mis-hits one for a change. He leaps out, can't get to the pitch and lofts with the spin without timing towards long-off.
more air, Vijay pushes it with the turn towards point but can't get the single
too wide outside off, Vijay lets it go and it is called.
short and flat from Warne, Raina swivel pulls to deep backward square leg.
keeps it outside off this time, Vijay pushes into the off side.
Vijay's shifting gears rapidly. He advances to Botha's flight once again, and launches him straight for a boundary. Just over the ropes too.
fuller on the toes, Raina leans out and drives through mid-on for a single.
full on middle and leg, pushes away into the off side

yorked him! Botha's nailed Hussey with some very brave bowling. It is a short boundary on the leg side, there's no midwicket, and he asks Hussey to go for the big slog sweep. Hussey goes for it, but the ball is through very fast and he can't get under it. Leg stump out of the turf.
fired in fast on the pads, Hussey can't get it away as he's hurried into the flick.
Warne looks to drift one onto the pads, Hussey is in a bit of strife but ends up playing a falling paddle sweep for a single.
Warne shortens the length, Hussey is not to the pitch and pushes it away to midwicket.
only Hussey knows how he plays this shot. He leaps out to Warne, gets to the flight and then lofts it over midwicket without breaking a sweat.
better feet, Vijay gets to the pitch and drives into the covers.
there you go Warne. Classy ball, slower, tempting outside off, drifting away slightly and then spinning big away from Vijay who misses it by a mile.
Hussey comes out again, works Warne with the spin through midwicket for a single.
Vijay jumps out this time, gets too close to the pitch and can't do much with it. Flicks straight to midwicket.
on the pads, Hussey flicks, Vijay runs and looks for a second, but they decided against it.
Hussey prances out, Botha follows him, full on the pads and Hussey digs it back to the bowler.
touch of turn away from Hussey who pushes the ball towards point.
pushed in faster, Vijay works it off the pads through backward square leg for one.
Vijay advances again, Botha keeps it shorter and he nudges through square leg for two.
Warne's not about to stop tossing them up, just yet. Fullish on the stumps again, Vijay pushes with the turn towards mid-off for one more.

Vijay has sent the ball into the fortress wall. Tossed up on middle and leg, not so much of the Warne drift or loop. Vijay dances down the track, gets to the pitch easily and bangs him over long-on. Lovely hit.
loopy on the pads, Vijay leans out and whips through midwicket for a single
a hint of drift outside off, Vijay opens the face and steers to point
drops short outside off, Hussey slaps it through wide mid-off for a single.
on the pads, Vijay nudges to square leg for one
aha, Hussey leaps out to get to the pitch and then smears Botha with the turn through the covers for four. Rajasthan call for the time-out. Something to break CSK's momentum.

huge appeal for lbw, Hussey survives. Boy, they may have changed the pitch, but it still turns a mile! This was landing close to leg stump from round the stumps, Hussey thought it was going down and let it go. It turned back big and hit his pad. The umpire got it right, it was pitching outside leg. Hussey looked quite worried for a moment.
Vijay works him in front of square for a single
down the leg side, Vijay smartly lets it go.
who would have thought Botha and Watson will misfield the same ball? Tossed up, Vijay comes out and drives it past a lazy Botha and then Watto at mid-off fumbles to allow the second.
tossed up outside off, slowly and defended into the off side.
oh boy, Hussey is looking better and better. He's shredded a short ball this time, marginally outside off and he's sent it packing through cover-point.

Amit has tried to bowl wide outside off from the other end, and on the leg stump from this end. In an attempt to deny Hussey the short boundary. No matter. Hussey has slammed him to the bigger boundary on both occasions. Too short this time, on the hips and Hussey swats it with disdain through square leg.
another charge from The Huss. He jumps out and goes for a bit heave to the leg side, but misses.
back of a length outside off, Vijay looks to hit it hard through the covers, but finds the fielder.
he's looking better now, moves into a pleasing cover drive, but finds the fielder.

the Vijay trademark imperious across the line lofted drive over mid-on. Looks elegant when it comes off, like it just did. Back of a length from Watto, outside off, Vijay plonks the front foot across and dumps it cleanly over mid-on.
Taylor saves a boundary in the covers, as Hussey cracks a short ball viciously. Taylor dives and stops it from racing away.
Vijay's feet aren't moving at all. Another airy nothing waft at a back of length ball outside off, but this time he eludes point.
straighter, on middle and off, Hussey pushes a single down the ground past Watto.
superb placement. Fuller from Watson, Hussey leans in and focuses on threading the micro-gap between mid-off and extra cover. Both fielders thought they had a chance to stop that. In their dreams.
aha, Hussey jumps out and has a big swipe to a short ball outside off. Play and a miss.

dropped by Rahane at point. Back of a length, not there for the drive and Vijay goes for an ambitious on-the-up drive from the crease. Poor shot, poorer effort. Rahane just looked lazy going for the straight catch and clanged it.
tossed up on the pads, Hussey whips powerfully and Amit misfields on the midwicket boundary to allow two. Hmm, Warne won't like that.
another strong cut from Vijay against Menaria, finds point. Gets a single this time as the fielder fumbles the save.
flighted on off, Hussey drives past mid-off for a single.
flat and on the leg stump, Vijay resists from swiping through the leg side and picks up a single with a nudge to square leg.
speared in faster on leg stump and Hussey pushes through mid-on for one more.
Hussey's making those surgical incisions into Menaria's dibblies here. Flat and no turn, on off stump, Hussey reverses the grip and slaps it through third man.
Hussey cuts from off stump line and still gets it behind point for another single.
angled into Vijay's hips and he looks to glance. Gets a single away through square leg.
width again, this time short of a length and he steers past slip. Rajasthan have protection at third man.
well, with The Huss, too much width outside off can be a bad thing. This wasn't all that wide, but it was in the slot and Mr. Cricket walked into a flowing cover drive. Crisp and clean.
back of a length and as expected, outside off. Hussey stays back and defends towwards point.
length ball on the pads, quietly pushed past midwicket for one. Expect Amit to be very straight to Vijay and wide outside off to Hussey.
forces a flat ball on middle and leg past the bowler and gets a single. Chennai off to a better start than they got to the other day.
cramps him for room outside off, and he cuts straight to point
aha, misunderstanding, but they get away with it. Vijay pushes to wide mid-on, Hussey goes a long way down before returning but makes it in time. The fielder did not pick it up cleanly.
speared in from round the wicket, Vijay defends off the back foot
gets it on middle and leg this time, and Hussey pushes to mid-on for one.
poor start. Menaria lands this well down the leg side and it is a wide.
bosh. First-ball four. Short and turning into the pads, easy swat pull for Huss past square leg.

all over. Raina's got the legend, and he has two wickets in three balls. Chennai are knocking on the doors of the play-offs. @ImRaina tosses it up outside off, @Warne888 smears it high over mid-off, and @newbigdog at long-off holds it easy.
defended down the track, first up.

Raina's turn to pull off another stunner. Tossed up outside off, Amit Singh hits it right back to the left of Raina, and it was travelling. Raina leapt across like a 'tracer bullet' and pouched it in one hand. Spectacular.

you just have to love Bollinger! The scorecard will say Botha c & b Bollinger, but that's not even half the story. Another bouncer, Botha top-edges this time and it pops right up. Bollinger calls for it and races down the track on his follow through. He takes it behind the stumps, next to Dhoni, and then lunges forward and tumbles and rolls like the very epitome of clumsiness. Dhoni watches with a half smile. All's Well, of course!
Amit Singh works a single to midwicket and hands it over to Botha.

Bolly puts Yagnik out of his misery with a thunderous yorker. Full, fast, gunning for leg stump and Yagnik's rituals in front of the stumps don't do much to deviate it off its course. Bollinger doesn't celebrate, he just walks back to his mark, while Yagnik walks back to the hut.
Yagnik top-edges the pull this time, awry as they come. Morkel moved slowly across from midwicket towards wide mid-on, but did not get close to it.
short ball, Yagnik is so late on the pull, he plays it straight back down the track.
beaten by the pace outside off, Yagnik fishes nervously inside the line.
how does one get Ashwin to go for runs? 4-0-24-2 today, as Yagnik poushes a single to retain strike.
again, he's stuck on the back foot and can't get it away.
Yagnik can't negotiate the turn as Ashwin breaks it away from off stump line.

Raut. Is out. All over, bar the shout. Chennai's fielding has been the personification of a curate's egg today. Ashwin lands this well outside off, Raut heaves from there to the leg side and midwicket had to run in to field it. Botha wanted a second, Rahane's run like the wind today, but this time he was caught short after responding late. The throw went to Ashwin, who collected and hurled down the stumps at the batsman's end. All over.
Raut keeps swinging. Couple of runs in front of square.
flat from Ashwin outside off, Botha gets it away to point for a single.
Raut backs away too far and then can't make contact with a full ball well outside off.
slower ball, offcutter on the pads, Botha pushes down to wide mid-on for one.
what a day for Botha to lose his timing. Back of a length outside off, slashes hard and hits thin air.
fuller this time, Raut mistimes the swing to the leg side, and gets a single.

Raut has been there 10 minutes or so, around nine of those lying down in pain, and yet produced two astounding shots. Another short ball from Bolly, Raut waits as it rises over middle and off, opens the face and taps it along over Dhoni's head between third man and fine leg.
short ball outside off, hustles past the batsman before he has a sighter. Swing and a miss.
tosses this one up, Raut pushes with the turn into the covers for a single.
short ball outside off, Botha mis-times the cut and gets a single
Raut's ankle is good enough for the jump out of the crease, and he gets another single to long on.
back of a length, Botha pushes him down past mid on for one more.
this time he gets a single, worked away off the pads to midwicket.
speared in on the pads, cautiously played back down the track.
short ball, aimed at those fingers again, nudged down to backward square leg for a single. Bravo's first spell in yellow comes to an end. 1 for 36.

boom to bust. Raut leaps out again, and twists his left ankle as he hops out. He's immediately in pain, and in no position to handle the short ball that thudded into his glove before ricocheting onto the left fore-arm. A few aching bones there, Raut is down for the count. Ouch.

beginning of a rout from Mr. Raut? We've seen some shots today, but this is close to the best. Offcutter lands short of a length outside off and cuts in. Raut was half way down the track, and it was in the slot. He did not over-hit it, though, and just drilled it through the line high and mighty over long-off. Shows the bat-maker's name for effect.
back of a length ball on off stump, Botha works it down to long-on for another single.
gets a short pacy ball outside off, and he upper cuts to third man for a single.

Raina's easily the best fielder in the Indian team, and here's more proof. Length ball from Bravo, Rahane looks to slam him wide of long-on, but it was too wide of off stump for him to get the placement. It was headed straight over the ropes though, behind Raina, until he leapt up and caught it a foot or so inside. Well-timed jump, and taken without a fuss. Is that the end of RR's chase? Put your hands together for Ajinkya.
armer hurries onto Botha who drags it wide of mid-on for a couple of runs.
speared in round-arm from wide of the crease. Pushed back down the track.
Rahane jumps too far out and gets too close to the pitch. He bunts a single to long on.
speared on the pads, Botha guides it to midwicket, Rahane wants two. No chance.
on the pads this time, Rahane works him to midwicket and gets a single.
Rahane's clattered another boundary to reach his 50. He leaps out to Jakati, reaches the pitch and slams him inside out just over the leaping Badrinath at cover.
over-pitched on off stump, Rahane steers through point for a single, and it is time for another 'stretch my legs' time-out.
on the pads this time, nudged with the angle to deep midwicket for a couple.
thump. Length fare from Bravo, outside off, Rahane walks into line and bangs it over mid-off. He's been really good tonight.

this is a really ragged fielding effort from CSK. Botha stays back to a very full ball pushes it down the track and hares down the track. Bravo tries to kick it onto the stumps on his follow through, and the direct hit would have nailed him easily. Miss. Dhoni misses too, and they get an over-throw. Over-kick. What ever.
slower ball outside off, forced into the covers for another tight single. This time the fielder, Raina,  hits the stumps, but Botha was in.
short of a length outside off, Botha forces it back to the off side of the pitch and Bravo cleans up.
slips his first ball down the leg side and it is called a wide.
Rahane keeps getting the occasional four, this time he's jumped out to Ashwin and dispatched him through the covers.

Jakati clangs it now. He's had an eventful day on the field. Tossed up wide outside off, Botha looked to swipe it across to the leg side and top-edged towards mid off. Jakati got under it, tried to take it Aussie style and then as he was overbalancing behind, the ball popped out.
fullish ball on leg, Rahane pushes down the ground for one more.
orthodox stuff from Ashwin, on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for one.

we've seen double bouncers, intentional slings, and some other variants from the bowlers in this IPL. Here's the latest from Jakati, who rolls his arm over once, doesn't release the ball, and then rolls it again. This time the ball comes out, and Botha chips uppishly over mid-on.
Rahane works him for a single behind square.
full toss on middle and off, Rahane slaps it right back past the bowler for four.
yes and no situation, Rahane plays it into the covers and they get a couple before thinking of a third late, and deciding against it later. Just as well.
another appeal, half for lbw and half for a catch There was some noise as Rahane went for the sweep, but it probably was going down the leg side. And was away from the bat.
half an appeal for lbw, turned down rightly. That was hurrying down the leg side when it hit the pad.
tossed up on off, Botha defends back down the track. Ashwin is controlling things superbly.

Ashwin's struck again, Doxy's gone and RR slip further. This time he pauses on his delivery stride, takes a look at Menaria's footwork and sends it down slow and short of a length outside off. It turns and bounces more than Menaria thought, and he ended up nicking it into Dhoni's gloves.
flat carom ball on the pads, whipped to square leg for a single.
goes for the cut this time, but Albie at short third man does well to dive and stop it. They get a single.
plays back again and steers a ball outside off to backward point.
Menaria stays back and forces a length ball back to the bowler.
fullisb ball to end the over, Rahane guides it straight to point.
Saha does well in the deep this time. Rahane is looking better and better. Width outside off, dealt with well as Rahane forces the cover drive along the turf, until Saha dives in its path.
on the hips this time, Menaria nudges to square leg for another single.
bouncer, called a wide for height. Menarie ducks under it easily.
full length ball outside off, Rahane steers to deep third man for a single.

Morkel's removed Rossco. More like Rossco has removed himself. Full ball, wide outside off, and Taylor scoops the drive in the air over the infield. Saha ran in from deep cover-point and took a good tumbling catch.
starts off with a length ball outside off, Rahane steers to point for a single.
hurries through Taylor and stays low outside off as he looks to cut. No contact made.
speared round-arm, down the leg side, and called.
turns away from off stump, Rahane pushes past point for a single.
pushes a length ball to long-on for one more
Taylor leans out and works with the angle through mid-on. Two more taken.

quicker and flatter, Rahane is late on the heaved pull, but boy, can he run! Deep midwicket and long on converge and end up confusing each other. Third run taken, in the process. Raina and Vijay were the culprits in the deep. They have had a few communication problems today, those two.
flighted on middle and leg, played defensively into the off side.
on the pads to finish the over, nudged with the angle through square leg for one.
fullish outside off, Rahane steers to deep point and charges back for the second. Taylor was very late responding, but the throw went to the wrong end.
length ball on off stump, pushed wide of mid-off for a busy single.
Bravo puts this one outside off, Taylor cuts past point for a couple and the 50 is up.
on the pads again, Taylor pushes it with the angle to mid-on. How long before we see the powerful shovel whips?
Bravo angles into the pads, and Rossco works him with the angle to midwicket.
on off stump, hit hard with the spin but straight to mid-on.

as always, Ashwin manages to get the important wicket. Tossed up on leg stump, Watson goes for the big sweep and gets a top edge. Was it a carom ball? The top edge stayed in the air a while, and Jakati called for it. He fumbled a couple of times, but eventually held on.
Rajasthan are getting the impetus now. Watson reaches out to the flight and his Ashwin through the linje over mid-off for four more.
on the pads again, played with the turn towards square leg.
swept away. Ashwin turns one too far down the leg side, and he controls the sweep well to get it past short fine leg.
length ball outside off, Watson steers to Jakati at short third man, who fumbles.
angled into middle and leg line to finish the over, Rahane can't get it away.
Rahane has some class, and here's the evidence. Touch of width outside off this time, and he lays into it with an accomplished cut in front of point.
shot of intent from Rahane. RR need a lot of those. Marginally short, he latches on early and smashes it with a crossed bat over mid-on.
another slower ball, Watson mis-times the heave and finds mid-on. Only the single.
slower ball makes an early appearance, 112 kph outside off, and Rahane steers to short third man for a single.
starts off with a sprightly short ball outside off at 131 kph and Rahane is very late on the cut. Play and a miss.
Rahane's away with a tight single. Length ball on off stump, he pushes to point and takes off. The under-armed throw misses at the bowler's end.
Another interesting call from umpire Hariharan, refusing a potential wide down the leg side as Rahane skips back inside line after moving away.

Dravid is gone, he seems to have got a feather through to Dhoni after attempting another pull. Bollinger keeps it short outside off, not as short as Dravid thought and the ball went under the bat and took the edge through. Huge noise on the replay.
Dravid backs away and has a big swipe to a pacy length ball outside off. He doesn't make contact. Bollinger, as he does often, fallls and rolls on his follow through.
short again, inviting Watto to pull to the longer side. He gets it away on the bounce to midwicket, standing halfway to the fence.
Bolly keeps it short, Dravid mis-times the pull and gets a single to deep midwicket.
low full toss on the pads, Dravid drives straight to mid-on and gets a tight single. Direct hit was needed, but the fielder missed.
long-on is back, so Watson's punch to a length ball on middle yields only a single.
angling onto the pads, Dravid nudges a single to square leg.
full toss outside off, Dravid pounces on it with a big square cut that flies away off the outside half of the blade to the backward point boundary.
short of a length outside off, Dravid can't do much with it and dabs towards point again.
fullish ball on the stumps, Dravid times the straight punch well, but the bowler gets a hand on it.
misfield, this time from Badri at cover point, as Dravid steers solidly. Single to the cause, RR need boundaries.
this time he gets a touch of inward movement from outside off, and Watson inside edges the cover drive onto his boot.
the Bolly bouncer barrage. This wasn't so steep, but it hurried Watto into the pull and he was quite late on it, playing it to mid-on.
wide down the leg side, Dhoni palms it away and they get an extra run.
that's a real pacy bumper at 144 kph, Dravid decides against pulling this time.
short ball, Watson pulls behind square for a single.

poor stuff from CSK. Short of a length outside off, Dravid pushes it to Bravo, electric at point. He swoops on it, collects and under-arms in a trice, and missed by very little. Watson would have been in trouble if it had hit. Raina over-runs the ball as he backs up, and it goes for four overthrows.
tight delivery on middle, Dravid whips towards midwicket for a single.
